newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products pulled higher by futures strength.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products pulled higher by futures strength.

text.p: NWE products were propelled higher on Wednesday by strong gains in futures late on Tuesday, traders said.
They noted, however, the markets were quiet due to the Queen's Day public holiday in the Netherlands.
Eurograde barges traded twice at $198 in two lots of 2,000, one for May 1-15 delivery and one for full May delivery. Eurograde was talked at $198/$198.50 a tonne fob ARA.
Traders attributed the gains to NYMEX unleaded's move higher on Tuesday. The May contract closed 1.02 cents higher at 63.36 cents a gallon and was a 0.04 cent up in ACCESS trading.
Gas oil was pulled higher by gains in IPE futures as they played catch-up with last night's crude futures' gains.
May IPE gas oil traded $1.25 higher at $170.00 a tonne at 0944 GMT.
API data released last night showing U.S. middle distillate stocks fell by 1.4 million barrels last week was also seen as supportive to gas oil futures.
The high sulphur barge market was extremely quiet due to a dearth of Dutch players. Price levels were assessed as slightly higher in line with crude futures gains ay $80/$83.
